title: Uni is hard. The maths is hard. Yet I did it. Therefore so can you #engineering #engineeringstudent
transcript: Uni's hard, the maths is [music] hard, the lectures are terrible, you're not getting any interviews, nothing is working out. You're lost. Guess what? I was there too, two or three years ago, studying electrical engineering, and a light bulb switched for me. I landed a life-changing internship, completely changed the way I saw life. I came back to university in my final year, I smashed uni. I got the best grades, and ultimately I landed another internship which led me to a full-time software engineering role at Europe's largest bank. How did I do it?
